brainchop.reason: Its model needs an 8351-pixel WebGL texture; SwiftShader and many GPUs allow 8192.

brainqcnet.reason: Its WebAssembly classification of the example outlasts 25 minutes in a SwiftShader Chromium; the app's own e2e test takes 3.4 minutes on 8 native cores.

cryo-em.reason: Its only example's movies stay on the compute server, so the tools cannot load it (examples.json automation.unavailable).

dwi2trx.reason: Streamline tracking needs 32-lane WebGPU subgroups; SwiftShader offers 4.

musclemap.reason: Its segmentation of the example outlasts 25 minutes on SwiftShader WebGPU; it needs a hardware GPU.

seedseg.reason: SeedSeg publishes no example in examples.json, so there is nothing for the tools to load and run.

syncro.reason: The example volume needs a 2,916 MiB GPU buffer; SwiftShader allows 1,024 MiB.

synthseg.reason: The cropped example still exceeds SwiftShader's GPU memory; the app suggests 1.3 mm voxels or a hardware GPU.

white-matter-lesions.reason: Its five-fold ensemble on the example outlasts 25 minutes on CPU WebAssembly in a SwiftShader Chromium.

zarro.reason: Its example is the chunks of an OME-Zarr store that the page assembles itself; open-url needs the address of a whole store.
